nodes.name: schema.prisma
nodes.summary: Defines the storefront domain schema for B2B quoting workflows, including B2BQuote, QuoteLine, OrderTemplate, and QuoteCounterOffer models with status enums and approval tracking.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Prisma multi-schema pattern with a dedicated SQLite datasource (STOREFRONT_DATABASE_URL). Outputs generated client to apps/web/generated/prisma-storefront.

nodes.name: schema.prisma
nodes.summary: Defines the tenant domain schema managing multi-tenant organization lifecycle, including TenantOrganization, billing via Stripe, onboarding steps, invites, audit events, POS registers, and EDI trading partners/documents.
nodes.languageNotes: Covers both tenant management and EDI document exchange (PO_850, INVOICE_810, ASN_856) within the same domain schema, outputting to apps/web/generated/prisma-tenant.

nodes.name: schema.prisma
nodes.summary: Defines the Warehouse Management System (WMS) domain schema covering fulfillment tasks, pick/pack flows, receiving sessions, carton packing, cycle counts, pick waves, putaway tasks, and labor event tracking.
nodes.languageNotes: The most extensive Prisma schema in the batch at 282 lines, covering the full physical warehouse lifecycle from receiving through dispatch with granular status enums for each workflow stage.

nodes.name: register-paths.mjs
nodes.summary: Registers TypeScript path aliases for all 14 Prisma-generated client packages at server startup using tsconfig-paths, enabling @/* and @/generated/prisma-* imports when running the API server via tsx.
nodes.languageNotes: ESM module using import.meta.url and node:path to resolve the web root, loaded before application code to ensure generated Prisma clients are resolvable at runtime.

nodes.name: tailwind.config.ts
nodes.summary: Tailwind CSS configuration defining the Cosmos design system with a dark-mode color palette (cosmos.*), custom font families (Jakarta, JetBrains Mono), and a bento border-radius token.

nodes.name: otel-config.yaml
nodes.summary: OpenTelemetry Collector configuration accepting OTLP signals over gRPC (4317) and HTTP (4318), batching them, and exporting traces, metrics, and logs to a debug exporter.
nodes.languageNotes: Configures all three OTLP signal types (traces, metrics, logs) through a single batch processor pipeline. The debug exporter is typically replaced with production backends (e.g., Jaeger, Prometheus, Loki) in deployment.

nodes.name: python-service.Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Dockerfile for a Python 3.11 microservice that builds with pip and produces a slim runtime image running uvicorn on port 8000 under a non-root system user with a health check.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a builder/runner multi-stage pattern to separate pip installation from the runtime layer, reducing image size. Creates a dedicated 'cosmos' system user to avoid running as root.

nodes.name: cluster-secret-store.yaml
nodes.summary: Defines a Kubernetes ClusterSecretStore resource named 'cosmos-aws-secrets' that authenticates to AWS Secrets Manager via JWT/IRSA, serving as the cluster-wide secret backend for ExternalSecret resources.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses External Secrets Operator v1beta1 with AWS IRSA (JWT) auth. All ExternalSecret resources in the cluster reference this ClusterSecretStore as their backend.

nodes.name: external-secret-redis.yaml
nodes.summary: Example ExternalSecret manifest that syncs the shared Redis URL from AWS Secrets Manager into a Kubernetes secret (cosmos-redis-url), providing REDIS_URL to BullMQ and event-bus services.

nodes.name: external-secret-storefront-database.yaml
nodes.summary: Example ExternalSecret manifest that syncs the storefront tenant database URL from AWS Secrets Manager into storefront-service-secrets, exposing both STORE_FRONT_DATABASE_URL and DATABASE_URL environment variables.

nodes.name: kustomization.yaml
nodes.summary: Kustomize overlay for the production environment that extends the base K8s manifests and scales the cosmos-web Deployment to 3 replicas with production environment labels.

nodes.name: kustomization.yaml
nodes.summary: Kustomize overlay for the staging environment that extends the base K8s manifests and runs the cosmos-web Deployment at 1 replica with staging environment labels.

nodes.name: init-databases.sql
nodes.summary: Bootstrap SQL script that creates 15 separate PostgreSQL databases — one per Cosmos domain — providing the multi-database foundation for the platform's domain-separated Prisma schemas.
nodes.languageNotes: Creates independent databases (cosmos_auth, cosmos_tenant, cosmos_inventory, cosmos_wms, etc.) rather than using schemas within a single database, enabling per-domain connection isolation.

nodes.name: main.tf
nodes.summary: Terraform root configuration for the production AWS environment, composing networking, RDS (db.r6g.xlarge, 200GB), ElastiCache Redis (r6g.large), S3, and EKS modules with an S3 remote state backend.
nodes.languageNotes: Production-grade sizing: multi-AZ RDS with 200GB storage, large Redis nodes, and EKS with GPU node groups for AI workloads. State stored in cosmos-tfstate/production/terraform.tfstate.

nodes.name: main.tf
nodes.summary: Terraform root configuration for the staging AWS environment, composing the same module set as production but with reduced sizing (db.t3.small, cache.t3.micro) and outputting all endpoint values.

nodes.name: main.tf
nodes.summary: Reusable Terraform module that provisions an AWS EKS cluster named cosmos-{environment} with Kubernetes 1.29, general-purpose t3.medium nodes (2-10), and an optional GPU node group (g4dn.xlarge) for AI workloads.
nodes.languageNotes: GPU node group uses taints/labels for workload isolation; desired_size is conditionally 1 in production and 0 in staging, enabling zero-cost GPU capacity in non-prod environments.

nodes.name: main.tf
nodes.summary: Reusable Terraform module that creates an AWS VPC with 3-AZ private/public subnets, NAT gateway (single in non-prod, multi in prod), and DNS hostname support for the Cosmos platform.

nodes.name: main.tf
nodes.summary: Reusable Terraform module that provisions an encrypted AWS RDS PostgreSQL 16.3 instance with a randomly generated master password, subnet group, security group, and environment-conditional multi-AZ and backup settings.
nodes.languageNotes: Automatically enables multi-AZ, 30-day backups, and deletion protection when environment is 'production'. Storage auto-scales up to 5x the allocated_storage value.

nodes.name: main.tf
nodes.summary: Reusable Terraform module that provisions an AWS ElastiCache Redis 7.1 replication group with automatic failover in production, a private subnet group, and a VPC security group allowing port 6379.

nodes.name: main.tf
nodes.summary: Reusable Terraform module that creates a private, versioned, AES256-encrypted S3 bucket (cosmos-documents-{environment}) for document storage with all public access blocked.
nodes.languageNotes: force_destroy is enabled only in non-production environments to allow clean teardown; versioning and encryption are always enabled regardless of environment.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for the @cosmos/analytics-engine private workspace package, defining build, lint, test, and typecheck scripts with TypeScript and tsx as dev dependencies.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel entry point for the @cosmos/analytics-engine package, re-exporting all public symbols from the cashflow, anomaly, and stats sub-modules.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the analytics-engine package, extending the monorepo base config with src/ as rootDir and dist/ as output directory.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for the @cosmos/types private workspace package, which provides shared TypeScript type definitions compiled to dist/ with TypeScript as the sole dev dependency.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Shared cross-service TypeScript type definitions for the Cosmos platform, exporting domain primitives including Role, Plan, JwtPayload, AuthenticatedUser, PaginatedResult, MoneyAmount, OrderStatus, OrderChannel, PaymentMethod, ServiceHealth, and ApiError.
nodes.languageNotes: Acts as the canonical source of cross-cutting domain types consumed by all API services and the frontend; no runtime code, purely TypeScript type/interface declarations.
